name: remote-mcp
description: Lean SSH/WSL execution and persistent-job MCP servers with on-demand help.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @remote-mcp/shared run build && npm --workspace @remote-mcp/ssh run build && npm --workspace @remote-mcp/wsl run build && npm --workspace @remote-mcp/imagegen run build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/shared/dist/shell.test.js packages/shared/dist/persistentJobs.test.js packages/shared/dist/taskManager.test.js packages/shared/dist/output.test.js packages/shared/dist/remote/edit.test.js packages/shared/dist/remote/patch.test.js packages/shared/dist/remote/diff.test.js packages/shared/dist/remote/fileTools.test.js scripts/tool-schema.test.mjs scripts/core-tools.test.mjs
